summary: Exact-type audit separates logical holding from the unchanged proof/assertion-policy package. Derive the exact negative universal-assertion consequence and construct explicit marker controls. Rejected treating a classical metatheory marker structure as intended intuitionist object semantics, inventing a known-proof/semantic bridge, or treating refutation of ∃p¬EM(p) as proof of ∀pEM(p). Existing object-EM alternative endpoints are deliberately preserved: moving withholding off the target would leave only its already-refuted weaker instance-denial, opening an unauthorized defended() path because the engine does not require coverage. This remaining authority gap is explicit rather than silently patched by generic Other or approval-by-removal. See docs/notes/excluded-middle-assertion-boundary.md.
